title:
This epic is used to update secondary button on Case Detail Tab Panel.
1. If the {@link ReliabilityAssetCase#currentState} is `Open`, then
  Show secondary button as `Close Case`.

2. If the {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert#currentState} is `Closed`, then
  Show secondary button as `Reopen Case`.
name: UiSdlEpicUpdateCaseDetailTabPanelButtons
